cli.services_status.supervised_by.note: Indented below a serve daemon row. unit is the actual systemd unit resolved from this PID's cgroup, not an inferred or installed unit name.
cli.services_status.supervised_by.role: Supervision evidence for one serve daemon

cli.services_status.unsupervised_scope.note: scope is the transient or login session scope read from /proc/PID/cgroup. Saying unsupervised is a safety-relevant distinction: restart cannot make this daemon persistent.
cli.services_status.unsupervised_scope.role: Warning below an unsupervised serve daemon

cli.services_status.unsupervised_unknown.note: Used when /proc cannot resolve a service or scope. Unknown cgroup resolution must be reported as unsupervised, never guessed supervised.
cli.services_status.unsupervised_unknown.role: Warning below a serve daemon whose supervision cannot be proven

cli.services_status.install_service.note: command is the complete CLI command with its current daemon port. It installs a distinct serve user unit, not the network relay unit.
cli.services_status.install_service.role: Action that installs supervision for an unsupervised serve daemon

cli.services_status.restart_supervision_.note: Distinguishes an in-place build reload from adding a systemd supervisor; restart semantics themselves do not change.
cli.services_status.restart_supervision_.role: Limit of the services restart remedy

cli.services_status.serve_install_linux_.note: Refusal on non-Linux hosts. macOS has no new serve supervisor in this change.

cli.services_status.serve_unit_written.note: unit is the absolute path of the new systemd user unit file.

cli.services_status.serve_install_isolat.note: The file write is separated from enablement: a redirected HOME cannot be managed by the real user's systemd manager.
cli.services_status.serve_install_isolat.role: Failed enablement under an isolated HOME

cli.services_status.serve_linger_require.note: The install is successful but not durable across logout; loginctl enable-linger remains a prerequisite.
cli.services_status.serve_linger_require.role: Durability warning after enabling a serve unit

cli.services_status.serve_install_not_se.note: error is the last active/health identity observation. Enablement alone is not accepted when an old daemon might hold the port.
cli.services_status.serve_install_not_se.role: Serve installation failed readiness or PID identity verification

cli.services_status.serve_install_wrong_.note: The responding MainPID must also be in local-operator-serve.service's cgroup; do not downgrade this to success.
